summary: Wellchange Holdings Co Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a best-efforts equity offering. The company issued 50,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.15 per share for gross proceeds of $7.5 million, closing on August 31, 2026. Prime Number Capital, LLC served as exclusive placement agent, receiving a 6% cash fee plus a 1% non-accountable expense allowance and reimbursement up to $100,000. Net proceeds are allocated to sales, R&D, expansion, strategic investments, and working capital. This is a routine capital raise under an effective Form F-1, not a special situation. No risk-arb angle or unusual event.
